lines.text: Just opened my laptop. Feeling productive.
Doug. It is two o'clock. The quarterly report is due at five.
And I respect that. Just pushed in my chair. Feeling productive.
He pushed it in. Then he pulled it back out. Then he sat in it.
Why is the sticky note talking?
I have been on this monitor since March. You pick things up.
Just replied to an email. One word. Thanks. With an exclamation point.
The exclamation point is doing a lot of work there.
It is doing more work than me. I am proud of it.
Doug. The report. What have you done on the report?
Just renamed the folder. Report, final, final, real one.
Yesterday it was called report, final. He is growing.
Okay. Sticky note. What does it say on you?
It says do the report. In his handwriting. With a little sad face.
Just moved the sticky note to the other side of the monitor.
Now I am facing the wall. I can see the plant. It is not doing well either.
Doug, you reorganized a piece of paper.
I reorganized my priorities. Feeling productive.
I am not doing this. I am going to sit down and wait.
Ugh. Just sat down. Feeling,
No. No, no, no. I am not saying it.
Say it. It feels so good. Let it out.
Just sat down. Feeling productive.
Welcome. You are one of us now.
We have a group chat. It is mostly pictures of lunch.
Wait. Stop. It is four thirty. The report, Doug. The report!
Oh. The report? That's done.
What do you mean done?
I finished it Monday. At nine fifteen. In the morning.
It is true. He wrote it so fast I fell off the screen.
Then why have you been doing this all week?
Because if you finish early, they give you more work.
So the folder called final, final, real one?
Has a finished report in it. Forty pages. With charts.
With charts?
A pie chart. And a bar chart. The bar chart is my best work.
Doug, this is the best report this office has ever seen.
Thank you. Just accepted a compliment. Feeling productive.
Which is why I am giving you the Henderson account.
The what?
And the Patterson account. And the holiday party.
This is exactly what I was afraid of.
Just gave Doug three new projects. Feeling productive.
Just put my head on the desk. Feeling,
Say it. It feels so good.
Feeling busy.
That is the worst word in this building.
Can somebody turn me back around? The plant keeps looking at me.
Just turned the sticky note around. Feeling productive.
Hello again. You are doomed. Have a good weekend.
